package.name: nros_geometry_consumer
package.description: phase-309 W4 codegen golden — a minimal Rust consumer that depends on geometry_msgs, so `nros generate-rust` (run in an edition container) emits the geometry_msgs bindings themselves. The generated MESSAGE SET is compared to a per-edition golden manifest, catching edition drift (e.g. jazzy's geometry_msgs has 33 messages vs humble's 32).
